description: Photo-composited meme of a man hanging posters at a movie-theater poster wall; the real posters are replaced with fake political movie posters: '45' (Donald Trump), 'TARMAC' (Hillary Clinton with a jet, referencing the 2016 Clinton-Lynch tarmac meeting), 'FISAGATE' (Barack Obama, James Comey, Andrew McCabe and other officials styled as a film with review blurbs credited to Reps. Mark Meadows, Jim Jordan and Matt Gaetz), 'RE-ELECT TRUMP 2020 - MAKE LIBERALS CRY AGAIN', and a Game of Thrones-styled 'SANCTIONS ARE COMING' Trump poster. Large red retro text reads 'ENJOY THE SHOW' with a 'QANON' signature at lower right; each frame is captioned 'COMING SOON'.
